generator_settings.values: uniform over the full domain of the declared column type
generator_settings.oracle_number_without_precision: 64-bit signed integer range (largest SQLite can store)
generator_settings.floating_point: double: full IEEE double range; float/real: full IEEE single range
generator_settings.date_datetime_timestamp: calendar years 1-9999, as day numbers since 1970-01-01
generator_settings.text: printable ASCII, length 0..declared length (char: exactly declared length), 255 when no length is declared
generator_settings.foreign_keys: value of a random existing parent row (parents generated first)
generator_settings.budget_charge_per_database: number of compiled objectives of the case study
